newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp 96 net profit slumps to 208 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Krupp 96 net profit slumps to 208 mln dmk.

text.p: German steel and engineering group Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp said on Wednesday its net profit dropped to 208 million marks ($121.7 million) in 1996 from 505 million marks in 1995, but it kept its dividend steady at five marks.
Krupp also said it expected its results to improve in 1997.
Group earnings on ordinary activities dropped to 336 million marks from 644 million marks, while earnings per share fell to 18 marks from 26 marks on a DVFA basis.
Group sales, however, rose slightly to 24 billion marks from 23.5 billion marks.
It said all its divisions but steel achieved a positive result on ordinary activities in 1996. The rise in sales was due to the first-time consolidation of units AST, Uhde and Bachmann.
Net borrowings were reduced by 500 million marks to under 2.9 billion marks, representing a halving of debt since 1993.
The worldwide workforce totaled 69,608 at year-end, up from 66,352 due to the consolidations.
-- Terence Gallagher, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.709 German Marks)
